mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 64 degrees with clear skies over the Military Ridge State Trail and a Waning Gibbous moon overhead.

The Verona Police Department Records Section is streamlining how you access official paperwork. If you need a motor vehicle crash report, you can typically find it online at crashdocs.org ten days after the event. For other records requests, please note that the department works to process these within ten business days and may require a fee for specific documents.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today. Looking into tomorrow, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's, plus live music and the downtown farmer's market coming up later this week.

In a noteworthy call from July 23, Verona police officers were dispatched to a residence on Lucerne Drive regarding a domestic disturbance, leading to the arrest of a local man for disorderly conduct and intimidation of a victim.
Today's Flavor of the Day is the decadent Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10:00 AM tomorrow.
